scope: Saiyan Saga cards 1–10; current V3 preview, not website publication

icon_system.constant: approved bold infinity with separate colon
icon_system.batch: All ten are attacks; one swords icon each.

rules_review: Original card powers compared; no named exception for these ten found in supplied Expanded CRD. Modern AT wording retained.
review_method: Actual original cards compared with each final exported card at normal size and enlarged facial detail. Confirmed corrections from October 30 retained unchanged. No illustration generation or repainting in this frame update.

cards.title: Orange Standing Fist Punch
cards.observations: Impact pose, open left hand, armor, scouter, tail and foreground Gohan retained. General startled/strained expression is compatible; the original faces are too soft for an exact mouth/eye verdict.

cards.title: Orange One Knuckle Punch
cards.observations: Piccolo close-up retains closed eyes, pinched brows and sweat; mouth and limbs are outside the original crop.

cards.title: Orange Two Knuckle Punch
cards.observations: Tight face/fist crop, occluded right eye, inward-looking visible eye, subtly raised mouth corner and cuff retained. Fine gaze/finger lines remain limited by the 298×410 original.

cards.title: Orange Leg Sweep
cards.observations: Bulma shocked eyes and open teeth/tongue mouth retained. Dark navy undershirt correction beneath the white open shirt is present; outstretched arms and pastel streaks retained.

cards.title: Orange Arm Bar
cards.observations: Frontal Raditz bust, broad hair silhouette, stern closed mouth, scouter, armor and cloud background retained. Original fine pupil/scouter details are resolution-limited.

cards.title: Red Lunge Punch
cards.observations: Goku crossed-arm guard, connected fists, orange gi, blue undershirt/wristbands and teal background retained. Original small mouth cannot reliably resolve open-mouth versus tooth shape; exact expression remains unresolved.

cards.title: Red Reverse Punch
cards.observations: Raditz tense close-up, narrow tooth-showing grimace, scouter and armor retained. Original fine mouth-corner and pupil detail is resolution-limited.

cards.title: Red Knife Hand
cards.observations: Vegeta asymmetric viewer-left glance is present: wider viewer-left eye with outward pupil, narrower opposite eye; stern closed mouth and blue/yellow/white armor retained.

cards.title: Red Palm Heel Strike
cards.observations: Chi-Chi stern closed mouth, inward brows, forward gaze, scarf and steering-wheel occlusion retained.

cards.title: Red Elbow Strike
cards.observations: Bulma open cheerful mouth and side glance retained, with arms behind head, blue strapless top, pale trousers, belt, pillar and lamps.
